glyph_origin: Oracle bone script: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 目 (“eye”) + 丨 (“?”). Used in oracle bone inscriptions as a sacrificial verb, the original character of 徝 or 循 ("to patrol; to follow"), and to denote compliance. Later forms containing 𠃊(直) are actually the original character of 置. Unrelated to 具 and 真.
